pandas-dev/pandas.about: The standard Python library for working with tables of data. Almost every data scientist, analyst and data engineer uses it daily.
pandas-dev/pandas.impact: Correct results for Arrow-backed data in pandas 3: regex classes match Unicode and Python whitespace, Series.mode works on booleans, and ffill/bfill no longer return a view that silently changes the original.

mlflow/mlflow.name: MLflow
mlflow/mlflow.about: Open source platform for building, tracking and evaluating ML models and AI agents, with an AI Gateway that routes requests to LLM providers.
mlflow/mlflow.impact: Keeps MLflow's AI gateway and tracking reliable: streaming responses carry correct content, token usage and tool definitions across Databricks, Mistral, Anthropic and Gemini, async logging keeps batches in order, and GenAI scorers accept NumPy values.

BerriAI/litellm.name: LiteLLM
BerriAI/litellm.about: AI gateway that lets apps call 100+ LLM providers like OpenAI, Anthropic and Bedrock through one API, with cost tracking and load balancing.
BerriAI/litellm.impact: In review: proxy keeps its internal callbacks, including per-model budget limits, when callbacks is configured as a single string.

unitycatalog/unitycatalog.name: Unity Catalog
unitycatalog/unitycatalog.about: Open source data and AI catalog for tables, files, functions and models. Its AI package turns catalog functions into tools for LLM agents.
unitycatalog/unitycatalog.impact: Keeps catalog data correct across the server, Spark and the CLI: Spark keeps column DEFAULT values, CREATE SCHEMA keeps its comment and location, column type names keep their case, DECIMAL(p,s) columns can be created from the CLI, and force-deleting a credential no longer breaks external locations. Also makes Unity Catalog functions work correctly as tools for AI agents, with arguments and results converted correctly for Anthropic, LiteLLM and the OSS client.

databricks/dbt-databricks.name: dbt-databricks
databricks/dbt-databricks.about: The official dbt adapter for Databricks. It turns dbt models into Databricks SQL: tables, views, incremental merges, comments and constraints.
databricks/dbt-databricks.impact: In review: correct column order for replace_where and microbatch below DBR 18.0, quoted struct field names, and escaped backslashes in comments.

databricks/databricks-sql-python.name: Databricks SQL Connector
databricks/databricks-sql-python.about: The official Python connector for Databricks SQL warehouses and clusters. Used by apps, BI tools, SQLAlchemy and pandas to run queries.
databricks/databricks-sql-python.impact: In review: NaN kept distinct from NULL, no ZeroDivisionError on fast CloudFetch downloads, and faster row iteration.

pydantic/pydantic-settings.name: pydantic-settings
pydantic/pydantic-settings.about: Official Pydantic add-on for loading app settings from environment variables, .env files, secrets and the command line, used widely with FastAPI.
pydantic/pydantic-settings.impact: Settings read field names correctly when validate_by_alias=False is used with pydantic 2.14.

delta-io/delta.name: Delta Lake
delta-io/delta.about: The open table format behind the lakehouse: ACID transactions, time travel and schema evolution on top of Parquet, used with Apache Spark
delta-io/delta.impact: In review: replaceWhere and generated columns with BETWEEN, case-insensitive CLUSTER BY, and Python clone returning a DeltaTable.

delta-io/delta-rs.name: delta-rs
delta-io/delta-rs.about: Native Rust implementation of Delta Lake with the deltalake Python package, used to read and write Delta tables from pandas, Polars, DuckDB and Arrow without Spark
delta-io/delta-rs.impact: Prevents silent data loss and wrong results: VACUUM keeps files still in use, deletion vectors and change data feed return the right rows, timestamps and decimal statistics are read and written correctly, and MERGE and ADD CONSTRAINT no longer duplicate rows or commit over violating data.

mindsdb/engine.name: MindsDB
mindsdb/engine.about: Open-source query engine that connects AI to databases like PostgreSQL, SQL Server, Databricks and MongoDB through federated SQL
mindsdb/engine.impact: In review: PostgreSQL, SQL Server and Databricks connector fixes for exact integers with NULLs, connection-string escaping and native queries.

lance-format/lance.name: Lance
lance-format/lance.about: Columnar lakehouse format for AI and ML data, with versioned datasets, fast random access and built-in vector and full text search, used from Python through the pylance package
